key_claims.claim: Invasive fetal cardiac intervention in hydropic fetuses with CHD is associated with improved survival compared to expectant management.
ART-conceived singletons have elevated risk of minor congenital heart defects, not just major CHD.
Fetal sinus bradycardia can be the presenting sign of serious inherited arrhythmia syndromes or structural cardiac disease with postnatal consequences.
Combined CNV-seq and trio-exome sequencing achieves 36 percent diagnostic yield in fetal polydactyly overall, rising to 61 percent in non-isolated cases with specific anatomical patterns.
NIPT high-risk results for rare autosomal trisomies have a PPV of approximately 4.5 percent; maternal CNVs are a frequent confounder and UPD disorders are not detected.
